Kedārakalpa
Texts bearing this name are classified below on the basis of details available in catalogues. First are placed mss. of which no detail is available; the second set of texts are those which are specified a. tantra in catalogues. The third set of texts are those about which the maximum amount of details is known. They represent the same text although in the catalogues they are assigned in the order of the majority of references to a. obscure purāṇa called variously Vikhyāda or Vikṣādha or Vidhvāntapurāṇa; the Śivapurāṇa; or the Nandī- [Page030-b] (ºĪśvara) purāṇa; an. described in these a.
